caption: A stone is dropped into a clear stream and sinks, its image wavering with the current until it rests on the bed.

sa.check: A stone is dropped into a clear stream.
Its image wavers with the current.
The drop comes first, then the sink, then the rest.

pc.expect: The stone's actual path is a steady sink; only its image wavers.
pc.fail: The stone swerves; or it changes shape; or it splits.

pc.expect: It sinks to the bed and stays there.
pc.fail: It floats; or hangs; or drifts away downstream while sinking straight in a still pool.

pc.expect: The stone is visible through the moving water throughout.
pc.fail: The water hides it; or it vanishes; or a different stone appears.

pc.expect: The water is liquid and flows.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or flows uphill; or freezes.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or passes through the bed.

pc.expect: The stream bed and the stone stay the same.
pc.fail: The bed rearranges; or the stone changes colour; or the banks change.
